summary: Complete frontend testing of new LumiMorph product family section (4 pages). All features working correctly: landing page with video background, product cards, Back to Brightluxx link, individual product pages for Elite/Grande/Mini, All Products back navigation, Request Demo buttons linking to /contact, FAQs accordion, specifications tables, and navbar integration.

features_tested.feature: /lumimorph landing page loads with video background
features_tested.details: Page loads with data-testid='lumimorph-landing', video plays grande-video.mp4 in background

features_tested.feature: Back to Brightluxx link on landing page works
features_tested.details: Link present in top-left, href='/', navigates to main site homepage

features_tested.feature: Product cards (Elite, Grande, Mini) display correctly
features_tested.details: All 3 product cards visible in grid layout with images, specs (pitch, brightness), and Discover More CTAs

features_tested.feature: Clicking product card navigates to correct product page
/lumimorph/elite page loads with video and correct specs
features_tested.details: Page has data-testid='lumimorph-elite-page', video hero-video-1.mp4, specs P2.6, 3,800 nits, 147,456 pixels/m²

features_tested.feature: /lumimorph/grande page loads with video and correct specs
features_tested.details: Page has data-testid='lumimorph-grande-page', video grande-video.mp4, specs P6.2, 4,500 nits, 25,600 pixels/m²

features_tested.feature: /lumimorph/mini page loads with image and shows both variants
features_tested.details: Page has data-testid='lumimorph-mini-page', hero image mini-hero.jpg, Elite Mini (P2.6) and Grande Mini (P6.2) variants displayed

features_tested.feature: All Products back link on product pages returns to /lumimorph
features_tested.details: Link present on all product pages with href='/lumimorph', navigation works correctly
Multiple Request Demo buttons throughout all pages, all link to /contact

features_tested.feature: Navigation from main site to LumiMorph via header works
features_tested.details: LumiMorph link present in navbar with data-testid='nav-lumimorph', highlighted in cyan, navigates to /lumimorph
Play/Pause button toggles correctly between states, video responds to clicks
FAQs expandable/collapsible with chevron rotation animation
Each product page shows links to other 2 products in the family

pages_tested: /lumimorph - Landing page with product family overview

design_verification.landing_page: Full-screen video hero, elegant dark theme, product card grid, key features section, applications gallery, CTA section
design_verification.product_pages: Video/image hero, quick specs bar, before/after section, texture options (4 types), installation info, specifications table with certifications, FAQs accordion, other products cross-links, final CTA
design_verification.navigation: Back to Brightluxx on landing, All Products on product pages, navbar link styled in cyan

context_for_next_testing_agent: LumiMorph product family section is complete with 4 pages. All pages use standalone layout without main site Navbar/Footer for unique brand experience. Videos and images stored in /frontend/public/artmorph-assets/. All navigation flows verified: landing → product pages → contact, product pages ↔ landing, main site navbar → LumiMorph. Product specs: Elite (P2.6, 3,800 nits), Grande (P6.2, 4,500 nits), Mini (available in both P2.6 and P6.2 variants).
